title: S2c stable prompt prefixes: rules before the packet placeholder in the four templates, prefix audit doc, per-role prefix reuse table (P7)
spec:
Stable prompt prefixes (P7), reduced after spec review T-1170. Facts: spawn.packet() prepends a 'packet v<hash> base <sha> sources ...' header before the body, and spawn._record_prefix_identity (landed with cache telemetry) already hashes everything BEFORE that header as prefix_sha/prefix_chars/dynamic_sections, which cache_telemetry.report and scorecard --cache consume (distinct prefixes, reuse_rate). Everything after the header is task-specific, so reordering sections inside _packet_body cannot lengthen the real prefix; the only lever is what sits before the header: the role template text, composed instruction modules and tool disclosure.
Do: (1) In the role templates that carry the packet placeholder (.orchestrator/prompts/execute.md, review.md, scout.md, spec-review.md; challenge.md has no placeholder and fix-round.md uses its own substitution, leave both untouched) move every rule sentence that today follows the placeholder to BEFORE it, wording unchanged, so the stable text precedes the task-specific packet; keep each template's meaning identical (same sentences, same order among themselves). (2) Audit and document in docs/hermes-hardening/09-stable-prefixes.md: the per-role launch differences that still break cross-run caching (per-role --mcp-config, --allowedTools, --disallowedTools lists in spawn.py, conditional instruction modules, tool disclosure levels) and which of them are unavoidable; the prefix_chars before and after the move per role, measured with spawn.render on a fixture task; and the statement that packet-body order is irrelevant to the prefix. (3) Extend scorecard --cache with a per-role prefix table (distinct prefix_sha, runs, reuse_rate) using the EXISTING prefix fields (no new field names, no bus.py change), so the effect of the template move shows up as reuse_rate over time; note the move date in the docs. No mode flag: this is a plain template change measured by the existing telemetry. Never change acceptance, scope or rule wording of any template.
Repository rules: unittest (not pytest), tests/_harness.py single ORCH_ROOT fixture; every acceptance test id tests/test_<module>.py::test_name is a method def test_name(self) in a unittest.TestCase. No new third-party dependencies. Never write secret values to any file or log; test fixtures use synthetic names and values that are not credential-shaped. Do not quote template placeholder tokens (double braces) anywhere in code comments or docs. Shadow-first: a new adaptive path never changes what a worker sees until its mode is active; shadow only writes decision_log or runs rows. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until green; the base suite must stay green. Do not ask questions: decide, and note decisions in the result summary. The interface contracts of the stage 1 modules are in .orchestrator/plan.md (section GOAL T-0991) and in docs/hermes-hardening/0*.md on this branch; read the merged module before building on it.
acceptance: tests/test_spawn.py::test_templates_with_packet_placeholder_put_rules_before_it (for execute, review, scout, spec-review the rendered prompt has no rule sentence after the packet header line; sentence set unchanged versus the previous template text)
tests/test_spawn.py::test_prefix_chars_grow_after_template_move (prefix_chars for a fixture execute task exceeds the count of the pre-change template, recorded as a constant in the test)
